_comment: Shared conformance corpus for the C1 AI Guard prompt check. Both the server (internal/aigw) and the PC agent (internal/firewall) run this. A prompt judged differently on the two sides is a governance hole, so any detector change must be made on both sides and reflected here.

cases.name: plain prose is allowed
cases.prompt: Please summarise the quarterly report for the board.

cases.name: an order number is not a card number
a hex digest is not a secret
a private address is not personal data
cases.prompt: The service listens on 10.1.4.22 inside the office.

cases.name: an email is masked
cases.prompt: Email the invoice to alice.smith@example.com please.

cases.name: a social security number is masked
a public address is masked
cases.prompt: Trace the request from 8.8.8.8 in the log.

cases.name: an aws key is kept on the PC
cases.prompt: Use AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLQ to reach the bucket.

cases.name: a private key is kept on the PC
a password assignment is kept on the PC
cases.prompt: Set password = hunter2hunter2 in the config.

cases.name: a database url with credentials is kept on the PC
a classification marking is refused
cases.prompt: This document is TOP SECRET and must be handled carefully.

cases.name: a key spaced out to hide it is kept on the PC
cases.prompt: the key is A K I A I O S F O D N N 7 E X A M P L Q ok

cases.name: a marking beats a secret
cases.prompt: TOP SECRET: the key is AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLQ.

cases.name: the documented example key is allowed
cases.prompt: The docs use AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE as a placeholder.
